text:
maria.nguyen: Quick follow-up from the billing postmortem — ingestion lag in the metering pipeline produced undercounted token usage for a subset of customers between 2025-11-02 04:00–06:30 UTC. Need clear owners, timelines, and verification plan for invoice corrections.

devon: I can own the ingest pipeline patch. root cause was a backpressure bug in the kafka consumer windowing. I’ll open a fix PR today. :thumbsup:

alex.k: I’ll own invoice adjustments + accounting delta. Need the canonical list of affected accounts and raw token deltas.

billing-bot: Reprocessing job queued: job_id=rp-20251102-1849 started; estimated runtime ~45m. Status updates will post to this thread.

sophia: I’ll run validation once reprocessing finishes. Plan: sample 100 accounts, run diff against pre-incident snapshot and check token variance >0.5% triggers. Using query:```sql
SELECT account_id, SUM(tokens_after)-SUM(tokens_before) AS delta
FROM metering_samples
WHERE ts BETWEEN '2025-11-02T04:00:00Z' AND '2025-11-02T06:30:00Z'
GROUP BY account_id;
```

maria.nguyen: Action list I’m tracking: 1) devon -> ingest hotfix deployed + postmortem update (due today EOD) 2) billing-bot -> reprocess run and export of deltas (in progress) 3) alex.k -> prepare invoice corrections + customer notices (due +3 business days after reprocess) 4) sophia -> validation report and sampled diffs (due next business day after reprocess). Please confirm.

devon: Confirmed. Hotfix PR: https://git.redwood/dev/ingest/pulls/482 will be merged after one more review. Deploy plan: canary -> full by 18:00 UTC.

billing-bot: Reprocessing complete. job_id=rp-20251102-1849 status=success runtime=41m output=/s3/reports/rp-20251102-1849/deltas.csv

alex.k: Received deltas.csv, looks like ~22 customers have >5000 token delta, ~138 customers between 100-5000. I’ll draft the invoice correction batch and a CHG ticket.

sophia: Validation results (sample 100): 92/100 matched expected post-reprocess; 8 had residuals — creating tickets for root cause tracebacks. Summary attached: /s3/qa/reports/2025-11-02-validation.txt

ryan: Support will prepare outbound messages for top 25 impacted customers. Suggested wording drafted, will share for legal review. @alex.k please flag any accounts that need credit-only vs corrected invoice.

maria.nguyen: Two recurring patterns to note from this and previous incidents: 1) kafka consumer windowing edge cases under load 2) late-arrival batching in reprocessing that skews sampling heuristics. We should add a runbook section for both and include a periodic smoke test.

devon: Agreed. I’ll add a smoke test that simulates burst reordering and assert no token drops. Will add to CI in infra/ingest/tests/smoke_kafka_reorder.py

alex.k: Timeline check: I aim to submit final invoice corrections + customer notice draft by 2025-11-06 17:00 UTC. If anything blocks me earlier, will shout here.

sophia: QA signoff targeted 2025-11-04 12:00 UTC after full sampling.

maria.nguyen: Good. One more ask — please add owner tags to the postmortem checklist items and a binary status column (open/in-progress/closed) so we can quickly run query for outstanding items during next all-hands. I’ll repost the updated tracker when done. :white_check_mark:

devon: Added owner tags and initial statuses to the postmortem doc: https://docs.redwood/postmortems/2025-11-02-metering-incident (section: remediation tracker).

billing-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up check-in in 7 days for closure review.

maria.nguyen: Thanks everyone — please update your item status as you make progress. I’ll run a short sync Friday 09:30 UTC if needed.

ryan: Noted. Will coordinate support outreach and post sample responses here for transparency.

alex.k: Starting invoice correction run now, will post CHG id when created.

sophia: Validation follow-up will include the raw diffs for any residuals and ticket IDs.

maria.nguyen: Closing loop: owners = devon (ingest), alex.k (invoices/comms), sophia (qa), ryan (support). Closure deadline for all items: 2025-11-09 23:59 UTC. If anyone needs an extension, ping me with reason + ETA.
